scope: Four fresh real-model q8192/out512 processes run OFF,ON,ON,OFF on the same whole/MoE/FLA/CK/CLI artifacts. Both arms retain combined exact attention and register PV. The sole environment difference is queued adaptive linear OUT mode0 versus mode2. All original prompt IDs, all512 GB10 output IDs, all512 actual streaming callbacks and the first-logit tolerance0.125 attach independently to every run. Only30 linear OUT correction owners change; the consumer, PPB1000 dense/PPB512 MoE envelopes and full-attention coarse OUT coefficient remain unchanged. The adaptive owner uses the original producer and K16 replay, bounded refinement, complete residual/RMSNorm interval endpoint certification and complete remaining-candidate fallback. It consumes no completed control or external reference values. Certification is conditional on the existing empirical producer envelope; observed violations force complete original candidate replay. Matching counts are diagnostics and are not the correctness authority. Two observations per arm are a limited repeated comparison. No prefix, long-context, HTTP package, retained-performance target or release acceptance follows.

decision.decision: Retain queued adaptive linear OUT mode2 together with combined exact attention and register PV as the next experimental q8192 control. Preserve code and packaged defaults. Continue structural matrix and recurrence work against the remaining product wall.
decision.rationale: Both ON observations are below both OFF controls. Median TTFT falls by712.7419 ms, or2.70745 percent. All2048 original GB10 output IDs and actual callbacks match with first logit10.375 and unchanged prompt and numerical bounds. Each ON process runs all30 adaptive layers and skips29191574 of58489767 original selected corrections, conditional on the existing producer envelope. No observed envelope violation is reported. Two samples per mode are limited evidence; TPOT medians are100.927955/101.305861 ms OFF/ON, so no decode speedup is claimed.
